issues.title: Ingest Franklin County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $17,360,269 across 29 funds. The largest: County General ($6,397,321), County Road ($3,684,066), EMS (Co Ord 86-11) ($1,943,564). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
